dedupe_keys.name: japan national land numerical information water supply facilities 上水道関連施設テータ p21

description: The water supply facilities layer (P21) of Japan's National Land Numerical Information, published by MLIT, maps the service areas of public and small water supply schemes as polygons and the locations of water treatment plants and related facilities, such as pumping stations and control centres, as points. Service areas carry the operator, scheme name, type (public water supply, public or private small scheme), population served and maximum daily supply in cubic metres; facility points carry operator, scheme, facility name and maximum daily supply. It was compiled from prefectural water supply maps and water supply statistics, and is downloadable by prefecture as JPGIS GML and Shapefile in JGD2000 coordinates, free but for non-commercial use only. Caveats: the newest edition is from 2012 with data as of fiscal year 2010, so it predates later mergers of schemes and new plants; where a scheme is split across areas the totals sit on the largest area and the rest carry -999; pipes and mains are not included. Simulation uses: linking treatment plants and supply areas to flood, tsunami and earthquake hazard layers, estimating population affected by plant outages, and seeding simplified supply-demand network models. Related records: the Japan MLIT dam statistics database (data-japan-mlit-dam-statistics-database).
